{{Top|leg}}
'''Option Ossus''' was a plan by the [[Jedi Covenant]] to destroy the [[Sanctum of the Exalted]]. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Lucien Draay]] ordered [[Feln]] to carry out the plan in [[3963 BBY]]. [[Borjak]] and especially [[Haazen]] was against the idea.

Ultimately, Feln executed the plan, when he thought that [[Zayne Carrick]]'s companions had come back to raid the Sanctum and detonated the charges. But the explosion also destroyed the village below. In anger, the other [[Feeorin/Legends|Feeorin]] turned on Feln and killed him.
